visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and a white shirt sits in front of a neutral-colored sofa. In front of her on a wooden table are several Chiikawa-themed food products from 7-Eleven, including rice balls, bread, and a rice burger box. She smiles brightly and gestures towards the items. (2) The camera cuts to various close-up shots of individual rice ball packages featuring Chiikawa characters like Hachiware and Usagi. Prices are shown as text overlays. The woman's hands hold the products up to the lens for better visibility. (3) The woman is seen eating a rice ball, showing the inside filling which includes a soft-boiled egg. Her expressions are exaggerated and joyful as she chews. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the food. (4) The scene shifts to dessert items, showing a Dorayaki pancake with a Chiikawa face branded on it and a pink bread package. She holds them up against a blurred indoor background. (5) A close-up shot shows a Tommi Rice Burger being pulled apart, revealing a stretchy cheese effect. The woman continues to eat and react with delight. (6) Several City Cafe cups with colorful Chiikawa designs are lined up on the table. The woman stands behind them, presenting the different designs. (7) The final phase shows a collage of all the Chiikawa products together on the table while the woman gives a thumbs-up and encourages the viewer with a broad smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female greeting in Mandarin, characterized by a bright, high-pitched tone and fast speech rate. A bouncy, high-tempo electronic pop BGM kicks in immediately, featuring sharp synthesizer hits and a driving percussive beat. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the speaker introduces the Chiikawa rice ball series. Her voice exhibits dynamic pitch variability to emphasize the character names and prices. The BGM remains constant in the background. (3) Soft plastic rustling sounds are heard as the speaker handles the food packages. The vocal intensity increases as she describes the fillings, followed by the sound of a 'ding' SFX when a price or key feature is highlighted. (4) As she bites into the rice burger, a subtle crunch and chewing sound are audible, though dominated by her enthusiastic verbal reaction. Another 'whoosh' marks the transition to the dessert section. (5) The speaker's tone shifts to a more 'cute' and softer delivery when describing the warm packaging of the bread, accompanied by high-register vocal inflections. The BGM tempo feels synchronized with the rapid-fire editing cuts. (6) The final phase features a loud, authoritative call to action to visit 7-Eleven, with the arousal level peaking. The audio concludes with a final 'pop' SFX as the video ends.

It aims to generate excitement and drive sales by showcasing the cute character branding, the quality of the food, and specific limited-time promotional offers.
